title: geonoma multiflora var. negrensis
intro: Geonoma multiflora var. negrensis, commonly known as the "Negrense Geonoma Palm", is a plant species in the family Arecaceae. It is a type of palm tree that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been reported to exhibit several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Geonoma multiflora var. negrensis include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
